Due to a long-standing contractual dispute, there is no direct travel route permitted between Office Alpha and Office Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to mutually exclusive service agreements, the itinerary must incorporate exactly one of the following two routes: the connection between Office Beta and Office Gamma, or the connection between Office Gamma and Office Delta.  

The objective is to determine the most efficient possible circuit that visits every office precisely once and concludes at the initial departure point.
